metadata.name: vanna_phoenix_multi_vault
metadata.description: Vanna multi-strategy basis vault on Solana: one USDC vault whose keeper spreads it over hedged Phoenix perp markets by funding and open interest

types.name: Config
docs: Protocol-wide roles and the Phoenix accounts the vault uses.

fields.name: keeper
docs: The bot that allocates the vault over its legs: it deploys, unwinds, moves margin and
re-hedges, within the limits the program enforces.

fields.name: phoenix_mint
docs: Phoenix's collateral token (PhUSD), minted 1:1 for USDC by Ember.

fields.name: global_vault
docs: Phoenix's token vault for `phoenix_mint`.

fields.name: swap_program
docs: The swap venue the keeper buys and sells the legs' assets through: Jupiter v6, or the
default key (swaps off: no deploys or unwinds; deposits and withdrawals still work).

fields.name: position_lots
docs: The leg's position after it, in base lots; negative is short.

fields.name: value_usd
docs: The deposit's value to the vault after its fee (USD, 6 dp).

fields.name: by
docs: The keeper or the admin.

types.name: Leg
docs: One market the vault can hold: an asset and its Phoenix perp.

fields.name: asset_token_program
docs: SPL Token, or Token-2022 for tokenized stocks.

fields.name: asset_account
docs: The authority's asset account; unset for the SOL leg (its SOL is in the trader account).

fields.name: asset_id
docs: The Phoenix market.

fields.name: active
docs: Whether the keeper may deploy into the leg; it may always unwind and re-hedge it.

fields.name: retired
docs: A flat leg the admin took out of the vault (`retire_leg`): it holds nothing, takes one
account in the leg list and no Phoenix call, so its market can no longer stop the vault.

fields.name: max_notional_usd
docs: Max short notional (USD, 6 dp).

fields.name: max_asset_units
docs: Max asset held, in its smallest units (the SOL leg stays under Phoenix's native SOL
cap per trader: 500 SOL on mainnet).

fields.name: max_oi_share_bps
docs: Max share of the market's open interest the leg's short may be, in bps.

fields.name: max_nav_share_bps
docs: Max share of the vault's NAV the leg's asset may be worth, in bps; 10,000 is no cap.

fields.name: after_hours_trading
docs: Whether the keeper may deploy while Phoenix trades the market after hours (stocks).

types.name: LegKind
docs: How a leg holds the asset it hedges.

types.name: LegParams
docs: A leg's caps; see `Leg` for each.

fields.name: to_phoenix
docs: True when USDC moved from the buffer into Phoenix.

types.name: MarketParams
docs: The Phoenix market a leg shorts: its asset id and lot and tick sizes.

types.name: SwapRoute
docs: A venue instruction built off-chain for the vault authority.

fields.name: accounts
docs: How many `remaining_accounts` after Phoenix's index accounts the route takes.

fields.name: sold_usdc
docs: True when the vault sold USDC for the asset.

types.name: Vault
docs: The multi-strategy vault. Users deposit and withdraw USDC and hold its shares; the keeper
spreads the USDC over the vault's legs, each an asset held with an equal short on Phoenix,
so the value stays flat in USD while it earns the funding longs pay shorts. Every leg's
short sits in one Phoenix cross-margin trader account.
The share price is the NAV over the supply, priced exactly as in the single-asset vault:
`NAV = idle USDC + Σ legs (asset held × mark × multiplier) + Phoenix equity`.

fields.name: id
docs: Picked by the admin at `create_vault`; part of the vault's address.

fields.name: usdc_account
docs: The authority's USDC account: deposits land here, withdrawals leave from here, and the
keeper deploys from it (the buffer).

fields.name: escrow_shares
docs: The authority's share account, holding the shares of pending withdrawal requests.

fields.name: leg_count
docs: Legs are numbered 0..leg_count; every deposit and withdrawal passes them all.

fields.name: pending_shares
docs: Shares in live withdrawal requests. Only these are reserved from the buffer: shares
someone sends straight to the escrow are not a request.

fields.name: max_tvl_usd
docs: Max NAV (USD, 6 dp) deposits may take the vault to.

fields.name: max_deposit_usd
docs: Max USDC one deposit may bring.

fields.name: entry_fee_bps
docs: Fees on deposits and withdrawals, in bps. They stay in the vault: they pay for the
keeper's trades that money moving in or out causes.

fields.name: buffer_bps
docs: Idle USDC the keeper must leave per dollar of NAV, on top of what pending withdrawal
requests are worth.

fields.name: margin_bps
docs: Phoenix effective collateral the vault keeps per dollar of total short, in bps.

fields.name: slippage_bps
docs: Price band around Phoenix's mark for the vault's orders and swaps.

fields.name: max_turnover_usd
docs: Max value the keeper may deploy and unwind per `TURNOVER_WINDOW_SECONDS` (USD, 6 dp):
bounds what churn could cost the vault.

fields.name: authority_nonce
docs: Part of the authority's address, picked by the admin at `create_vault` (little-endian
u64), so nobody can claim the vault's Phoenix trader before the vault exists.

types.name: VaultParams
docs: The vault's caps, fees and trading limits; see `Vault` for each.

fields.name: shares
docs: Shares back to the user.

fields.name: fee_shares
docs: Shares burned as the exit fee (none for a request the keeper returned).

types.name: WithdrawRequest
docs: A withdrawal waiting for the keeper to raise its USDC. Its shares sit in the vault's escrow
and keep earning (or losing) with everyone's until it is fulfilled at the NAV then; the
user can cancel it until then.

fields.name: returned
docs: The keeper gave up on paying it (`return_withdraw`): its shares no longer reserve the
buffer, and its user can only take them back (`cancel_withdraw`).

fields.name: payout_usd
docs: The shares' value before the fee (USD, 6 dp).

fields.name: usdc_out
docs: The USDC the user received.

fields.name: request_id
docs: The request this fulfilled; none for an instant withdrawal.
